title: Reporter Liquid template test suite
description: Cases that render a Liquid template against known data and check the output. Paths are relative to this file.

whitespace.description: "exact" (default) compares the output as-is, ignoring only line-ending style and a final newline. "collapse" ignores whitespace between tags and treats any run of whitespace as one space.

allowWarnings.description: Let the case pass while filters warn about missing data. Off by default: a warning with known data usually means the data or the template is wrong.

check.description: One small, named assertion about part of the output. Reported on its own, so a failure names what broke.

name.description: Says what the check proves, e.g. "the total includes tax". Shown in the report and the Testing view.

selector.description: A CSS selector for the elements to check, e.g. "h1", "table tr", "#includeNotes", "td:nth-child(2)". The output is parsed the way a browser parses it. On its own, it checks that something matches.

tableWith.description: With "row": look only in tables that also have a row with this label, e.g. "Crystallisation amount". This is how a check says "the Plan name in this table" when the label repeats, without depending on where the table is.

row.description: The label a table row starts with, e.g. "Plan name" (a trailing colon doesn't matter). The check looks at the cell beside that label, in every row with it. Survives tables being added or moved, where a position doesn't. Can be combined with "selector" to look only inside what it matches.

exists.description: true: the selector matches something. false: it matches nothing.

count.description: How many elements the selector matches.

text.description: The text of the matched element as a reader sees it (whitespace collapsed, entities decoded). A single value needs the selector to match exactly one element; a list checks each match in order.

contains.description: With a selector: text the matched elements' text must contain. Without one: text the page must mention, read as a reader sees it (not the HTML).

notContains.description: With a selector: text the matched elements' text must not contain. Without one: text the page must not mention, read as a reader sees it (not the HTML).

attributes.description: Attributes of the one matched element: a value it must equal, true (must be present) or false (must be absent). E.g. { "checked": true }.

template.description: The .liquid template every case renders, unless a case names its own.

name.description: Shown in the Test Explorer and the report. Keep it unique within the suite.

template.description: Overrides the suite's template for this case.

data.description: A path to a .json data file, or the data inline as an object. Omit to render with no data.

expected.description: A file holding the exact expected output. If it does not exist yet, run the case and accept its actual output to create it.

notContains.description: Text the output must not contain.

checks.description: Small named checks on parts of this case's output, each reported on its own.
